uncited: *   **Kernel Support:** The spatial extent of the splatting kernel.
This determines how many detector pixels are updated per voxel.
*   **Data Races:** In forward projection, multiple voxels may update the same detector pixel simultaneously.

*   **Time Complexity:** The complexity is proportional to the number of voxels times the kernel support size for forward projection, and the number of detector pixels for correction image computation.
Back-projection is proportional to the number of voxels times the kernel support size.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storage for the volume, two 2D images (ray-sum and weights), and the correction image.
*   **Limitations:** Data races in forward projection require atomic operations, which can reduce performance on some GPU architectures.
*   **When Not to Use:** Not given in the sources.
